Lovely spot with great cocktails, friendly staff and relaxed vibe.
Sep 2025 • Couples
Great cocktail bar, with a lovely atmosphere and high quality cocktails. 

They both serve advanced mixology style compositions crafted by a highly skilled staff, and a great selection of classics.

The staff were very attentive and professional, and a playlist full of carefully selected music underlined a laidback and friendly vibe. 

We returned to this lovely spot for a relaxing nightcap three nights.

Creative and the best downtown
May 2025 • Friends
If you are in Hanoi you can not miss one of the pioneering cocktail bars of the capital within walking distance of the main center. The cocktail I liked the most was the one inspired by the flavors of traditional Pho that is prepared by “setting fire” to alcohol: to be taken even just for the show. The advice if you can choose is to go Sunday with live music!

A must visit
Feb 2025 • Couples
A must visit when in Hanoi- Ne is a beautiful spot for cocktail lovers. The menu is detailed, the service is well informed and one of the only bars that offered us a glass of water as soon as we sat down- something we are used to but didn’t get at Polite and Co. or Bee’z Nee’s Speakeasy. We ordered two cocktails and both were out of the world- we would surely go back here again and again. You would also meet fun solo travellers or travelers with good taste here.
